obernants.approximation_semantics: Scoped mathematical relation, distinct from floating-point implementation and finite evidence. No shared percentage metric.
obernants.assumptions: Curvature bound is a caller premise, not inferred from knots. Overflow, work limits and allocation failures do not count as small approximation errors. Integer certificates do not provide a shared parent percentage or universal speed gain.
obernants.domain: Unsigned feasible item/subset instances and accepted 1/2/5/10 percent tiers; ordered integer knots and in-domain queries; checked integer vector dot domain and explicit quantization step.
obernants.evidence: model.md#wave19-evidence; exact transitive revisions in source_bindings.

obernants.operator: Exclude infeasible or over-optimal FPTAS outputs, violated declared loss bounds, extrapolated interpolation, and true dot errors outside the absolute certificate. Exclude promotion of caller curvature to checked fact and promotion of L1-normalized dot error to cancellation-relative error.
